about: A task journal reader that takes every line for a record, torn or not: every check that must leave the fragment unread fails.

mutations.find: export const journalLine = (line) => ((r) => (r && typeof r === "object" && typeof r.kind === "string" ? r : null))(parsedLine(line));
mutations.replace: export const journalLine = (line) => parsedLine(line) ?? { kind: "torn", line };
